en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 201 - It is narrated from Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Ja’far Himyari from his father from Ahmad bin Hilal from Umayyah bin Ali Qaisi from Salim bin Abi Hayya from Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) that he said:
“When three names, Muhammad, Ali, and Hasan come in consecution, their fourth is the Qaim (a.s).”
